Tile map designs, round 3

Four blends of round 2's watercolour terrain with its crisp three-quarter objects, no filters used. Each shows the boss beside the gate door, enemies with skull pips, and the hero's four step tiles. Round-2 designs 1 and 3 are at the end for comparison. Tell me which to take further. Tell me which numbers to take further.

1

A. Wash ground, inked objects

Seamless watercolour ground with a thin ink outline on the tall trees, cliffs, gate, shrine, shop and chest.

2

B. Wash ground, painted objects

Same ground; objects have no outlines, only soft painted shading and a gentle drop shadow that anchors them.

3

C. Higher camera, contact shadows

Camera tilted more top-down: shorter cliffs and squatter trees, tight contact shadows under every object.

4

D. Rich terrain, step cues

Flowers, pebbles and puddles in the grass; tiny corner ticks appear only on the hero's four step tiles.
